chunks: And whatever is in it from Jaʿfar ibn Nājiyah, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥasan ibn Muttayl al-Daqqāq, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr al-Bajalī, from Jaʿfar ibn Nājiyah.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Jaʿfar ibn Nājiyah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Jaʿfar ibn Nājiyah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance is bibliographical and related to hadith transmission, identifying the intermediaries in the chain rather than conveying a legal or theological matn.
